title: Spatial domain selection and regional expression consistency in colorectal cancer Visium data
description: Scientific analysis code and inputs for regional expression comparisons in 22 colorectal cancer Visium sections from 12 patients. The workflow includes regional expression profiles, connected-domain selection, modeled-composition sensitivity analyses, spatial resampling and simulation. It produces the main figures and tables and supplementary figures S1–S11 and tables S1–S19 from original counts and archived publication maps. The domain-refitting code is provided separately; the original fitting environment was not completely version locked. Third-party data and software retain their own terms. The repository contains materials under distinct terms: project materials use the repository LICENSE, spacexr source excerpts use GPL-3, and third-party datasets retain their source terms. Individual stages and figure generation were run and compared with reported results; a complete uninterrupted execution of the combined entrypoint and a complete refit of the original domain maps have not been validated.
